blocks.t: KINETIC MOLECULAR DESCRIPTION OF THE STATES OF MATTER

Spatial arrangement of mol e cules in a gas (a), a liquid (b), and a solid (c). Because the mol e cules in a solid or a liquid are in close contact with one another, the volume per mol e cule of the substance is nearly equal to the volume of the mol e cule itself. The mol e cules in a gas are much farther apart, with considerable open space between them. (Courtesy Dr. Stuart C. Watson and Professor Emily A. Carter/Princeton)
